title: Interest Rates and the Application of Collections — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery Rate Card
content:
Interest terms and the order in which money is applied, for each debt type in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**.

| Debt type | Annual interest rate (percent) | Interest may start after the notice (calendar days) | How interest is computed | Order of application within one debt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 0.00 | 30 | Simple monthly interest on the balance at the start of each month | Principal |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 0.00 | 30 | Simple monthly interest on the balance at the start of each month | Principal |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 0.00 | 30 | Simple monthly interest on the balance at the start of each month | Principal |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 0.00 | 30 | Simple monthly interest on the balance at the start of each month | Principal |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 0.00 | 30 | Simple monthly interest on the balance at the start of each month | Principal |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 4.00 | 30 | Simple monthly interest on the balance at the start of each month | Interest first, then principal |

| Debt type | One benefit offset across several debts | Designated direct payment applied to the designated debt | Smallest overcollection refunded (USD) | Refund issued within (calendar days of the overcollection posting) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | Earliest notice date first | Yes | 1.00 | 30 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | Earliest notice date first | Yes | 1.00 | 30 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | Earliest notice date first | Yes | 1.00 | 30 |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | Earliest notice date first | Yes | 1.00 | 30 |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | Earliest notice date first | Yes | 1.00 | 30 |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | Earliest notice date first | Yes | 1.00 | 30 |

## Card notes

- An annual rate of 0.00 percent means no interest is charged on that debt type; the Home Loan Guaranty Debt is the only type with a rate above zero, at 4.00 percent a year.
- "Simple monthly" means simple interest on the balance at the start of each month.
- "Interest first, then principal" means that within one Home Loan Guaranty Debt a collection pays accrued interest before principal; on the other types every collection goes to principal.
- "Earliest notice date first" is the basis on which a single benefit offset is spread across several of the debtor's debts.
- A designated direct payment is applied to the debt the debtor names rather than by the multi-debt order.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Two debts of one debtor, a Disability Compensation Overpayment noticed earlier and a Home Loan Guaranty Debt noticed later, both open for collection: one benefit offset reaches the compensation overpayment first, because its notice date is earlier. Within the Home Loan Guaranty Debt, any amount that reaches it pays accrued interest before principal.
